what: the landing funnel's print kit: each file is in its print pose and was measured and gated as it lies (tools/funnel_kit.py)
bought: tools/import_box.py BOUGHT_LIST and FASTENERS (the page's Bought table): gearmotors, switches, probes and sleeves, the four hold-down keys
not_in_the_kit: the stand's mast (15 longer): not drawn
optimise: box_funnel_half_nose, box_funnel_half_tail, box_funnel_arm: engine pieces, stage OPTIMISE (only once Spark's tests freeze the prototypes' interfaces); not printed

pieces.name: box_funnel_proto_half_nose
pieces.pose: upside down: the two rims behind the side walls' top edges and the rib's top on the bed
pieces.supports: yes (tree), everywhere over 45 deg: under the beam (to 81 over the bed), the motor seats and the ledges. The ledges' plastic face stands 0.4 under the seat plane, so a scar there never touches a drone; scrape the strips' pocket floors flat before gluing the strips

source.slicer: PCTG, PETG profile + 10 C (nozzle 260, bed 80), 0.2 layers, 6 walls, 12 top / 12 bottom layers, 25 % gyroid, brim 5

slicer_estimate.how: PrusaSlicer 2.7.2 slice of this file at the kit's settings (0.2 layers, 6 walls, 12 top / bottom, 25 % gyroid, brim 5, organic supports over 45 deg, 8 mm3/s cap, A1 mini limits); Bambu Studio's own estimate will differ

pieces.published: the release's file is CI's make of this piece (same solid, its own triangulation), solid check PASS in CI (print.json make.solid)
